title: Princess Leia's Hair
description: PRINCESS LEIA'S HAIR was the subject of much talk when it looked like a pair of black Danish pastries had been pinned to her head in STAR WARS. By RETURN OF THE JEDI, the princess had a couple of hair stylists, Patricia McDermott and Paul Le Blanc, who gave her this natural, primitive look for Endor (front sketch by Le Blanc). She also got to disguise herself as bounty hunter Boushh (back by Nilo Rodis-Jamero) to infiltrate Jabba's palace.
